specs.name: bursty_offload
specs.system: bursty requests: bursts of 8 (0 ns apart) arriving as a Poisson process, 2 requests/us on average
specs.description: Sin/cos offload for an 8-channel sensor front end: bursts of 8 requests arrive as a Poisson process, 2 requests/us on average; p99 request latency must be <= 0.4 us. Max error <= 2^-10. Minimise LUTs + FFs.

specs.name: dds_sfdr
specs.system: DDS feeding a mixer: one phase word every 5 ns (200 MS/s), FIFO depth 16, NCO stalls when it is full
specs.description: DDS phase-to-amplitude converter at 200 MS/s feeding a mixer through a 16-deep FIFO; the NCO must never stall (sustained 200 MS/s) and the synthesised tone needs SFDR >= 90 dBc. Max error <= 2^-13. Minimise LUTs.

specs.name: multiaxis_control
specs.system: control loop: a tick every 1 us issues 32 requests at once (32 requests/us on average)
specs.description: Shared sin/cos unit for a 16-axis motor-control loop: a 1 MHz control tick issues 32 requests at once (Park + inverse Park per axis); all 32 results must be back within 0.44 us of the tick (p99 over ticks). Max error <= 2^-12. Minimise LUTs + FFs.
